'''Gamma group''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|group]] of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It took part in the [[Raid on the Tropsobor|raid on]] the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' during the [[Sepan campaign]].
